description: This Java class implements a security store for LWM2M security information using Redis as backend. It manages security info by endpoint and identity, with locking for concurrency, and handles security modes, PSK identities, and registration data.

classes.name: TbLwM2mRedisSecurityStore
classes.description: A Redis-based implementation of a security store for LWM2M security info, supporting retrieval, insertion, and deletion of security data by endpoint and identity.

methods.name: getByEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves security info for a given endpoint, decoding from Redis and handling security modes.

methods.name: getByIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves security info by device identity from Redis.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores security info in Redis, updating PSK mappings and handling concurrency.

methods.name: getTbLwM2MSecurityInfoByEndpoint
methods.description: Fetches security info object directly by endpoint.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes security info for a given endpoint from Redis.

methods.name: toLockKey
methods.description: Generates lock key string for a given endpoint.

methods.name: getSecurityModeByRegistration
methods.description: Determines security mode from registration data stored in Redis.
